thread:
sam: Heads-up: created RC candidate `rc/v0.35.1-hotfix` to address a critical dependency CVE discovered in the tokenizer lib.
tag: `rc/v0.35.1-hotfix` artifact: gs://redwood-builds/rc/v0.35.1-hotfix.tar.gz
Quiet window requested: 2026-03-21 23:30-00:30 UTC. Requesting ops + security signoff.

tara: what's the plan for rollout? can we darklaunch or do a staged canary?

sam: staged canary: 0.5% -> 5% -> 50% -> 100%. KV-warm at each step. We'll hold feature flag false until 50%.

pm-aaron: release notes: call out CVE fix, risk: none to existing traffic, migration: none. I'll draft short blurb.

security-bot: [automated] CVE-2026-03-19-1234 detected in tokenizer v2.4. Patch applied in branch hotfix/tokenizer-cve. SBOM updated. Risk score: high. Recommend patch deploy within 24h.

sre-aly: happy to sheriff the window. I'll be oncall 23:15-00:45 UTC. If error-rate > 0.3% for 3m or p99 latency regresses > 2x, call rollback.

deploybot: [bot] Preflight started at 5314312100. Running artifact verification, schema checks, infra compatibility.

deploybot: [bot] Preflight FAILED at 5314312145: schema-lint error in config: new retry_policy field unexpected by old infra shim.

sam: hmm. that lint is from infra shim mismatch. We can either strip the field at build or pin shim. Which is faster?

tara: ops: can we pin runtime shim to v1.14 for this window? that would accept retry_policy.

ops-bot: [automation] Runtime shim pin requires approval. Available shim versions: v1.13, v1.14. Pinning to v1.14 will delay promo by ~10m for infra rollout.

sam: prefer fast path: strip retry_policy in release build and re-run preflight. Tara, can you coordinate with build?

tara: on it. Pushing build w/ retry_policy removed. New artifact will be rc/v0.35.1-hotfix-2 once uploaded.

sam: rolling update plan: preflight -> canary 0.5% (10m) -> 5% (10m) -> 50% (15m) -> GA. Rollback target: rc/v0.35.0. Keep DB write path identical.

deploybot: [bot] New artifact uploaded: gs://redwood-builds/rc/v0.35.1-hotfix-2.tar.gz. Preflight queued.

deploybot: [bot] Preflight PASSED at 5314312380 0 checks green (artifact verify, config lint, smoke on staging). Approvals required: pm-aaron, sre-aly, security-bot.

pm-aaron: approved :white_check_mark: 

security-bot: [automated] security review complete: SBOM verified, no additional secret exposures. approve=security-bot.

sre-aly: approved. I'll escalate on anomaly.

sam: initiating promotion at 23:35 UTC (after final infra warm). KV warming scheduled by ops-bot.

ops-bot: [automation] KV warm jobs: staging 23:32 UTC, prod-canary 23:34 UTC. Starting canary 0.5% at 5314312450.

deploybot: [bot] Canary 0.5% started at 5314312455. Observability hooks enabled.

sam: monitoring traces and error budgets. Tara watching deploy logs.

ops-bot: [automation] Canary 0.5%: health ok but sporadic 502s from edge at 23:36. Noted ~0.05% of requests. Investigating.

sre-aly: I see a bump in edge 502s x-ray. canary traffic shows internal retries flooding auth service. Might be related to stripping retry_policy.

tara: rollback option A: promote shim v1.14 which accepts retry_policy; option B: re-add minimal retry_policy with conservative limits and repromote. Thoughts?

sam: we need to be cautious. For now, pause promotion and hold canary. Do not proceed to 5%.

sre-aly: agreed. call rollback if 502s exceed 0.2% sustained for 5m. Current at 0.05% spike. Continue to debug.

deploybot: [bot] Canary paused at 5314312490 per manual hold by sam. No rollback executed.

t ata?

ops-bot: typo ignored.

pm-aaron: update on release notes: will add note about hotfix and a short blurb on the brief canary pause.

tara: quick test: re-enable a minimal retry header in the canary container without full field (runtime safe). Pushing tiny patch.

deploybot: [bot] Patch uploaded: gs://redwood-builds/rc/v0.35.1-hotfix-3.tar.gz. Running preflight for hotfix-3.

deploybot: [bot] Preflight PASSED at 5314312560.

sre-aly: new canary resumed at 5314312580. Metrics look stable. 502s dropped back to baseline. Proceeding to 5% at 23:46 UTC.

sam: good call. Keep the rollback snippet handy:
```bash
# rollback to previous GA
deploybot promote --artifact gs://redwood-builds/rc/v0.35.0.tar.gz --to prod --tag rc/v0.35.0
```

pm-aaron: will announce GA once 50% stable for 15m and SRE gives thumbs.

sre-aly: monitoring. will call rollback if regressions reappear.

sam: thanks all. marking thread resolved for now 1: will post final GA when complete.
